title: Script, mouse over popup doesn't stay closed
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e], v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935
~Not reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]~

Update:
The issue also occurs in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935], when single window mode is disabled (default).
It didn't happen in v4.6.2.stable because single window mode was enabled.
As Kitbdev pointed out: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119213#issuecomment-4390136703

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the script editor, the mouse over popup, on for example the method _ready, doesn't stay closed when:
- pressing esc
- moving the cursor with the arrow keys
- or when typing

Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]

Video description:
The mouse is clicked in the print statement, to place the cursor.
The mouse pointer is moved away so that it doesn't cover the cursor, it stops on the _ready method name, a popup opens with the description for the _ready method.

Esc is pressed, the popup briefly closes before re-opening.
Esc is pressed two more times, the popup opens again after each press.

The right arrow key is pressed two times, the popup closes and re-opens.
The left arrow key is pressed two times, the popup closes and re-opens.

abc is typed, the popup closes and re-opens.

Esc is held for more than one second, now the popup stays closed.

The left arrow key is pressed and abc is typed, the popup stays closed.

Alt + tab is pressed to switch to Notepad.
Alt + tab is pressed to switch back to Godot, the popup opens again.

Esc is pressed twice, the popup re-opens each time
Esc is held, and the popup stays closed.

End of video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73e83bac-e5f2-4877-acf8-a95c1b78f910

~Not reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]~
Update: It's not reproducible in either 4.7.beta1 or 4.6.2 when single window mode is enabled, it's disabled by default.
In the video below single window mode was enabled.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/261c2645-c664-476e-a073-d36c20f3215b

Workaround:
The popup stays closed when esc or any key is held for more than one second.
However, the popup returns when alt + tabbing to another app then back to Godot.

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [script-mouse-over-popup-doesn't-stay-closed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27362227/script-mouse-over-popup-doesn.t-stay-closed.zip)
- open the script: node_2d.gd
- in the script editor, click in the print statement, in the text: 'test'
- move the mouse pointer to the _ready method name, a popup appears with the description for the _ready method
- press esc

Issue:
The popup doesn't stay closed, it re-opens. It also re-opens when moving the cursor with the arrow keys, or after typing.

Expected:
Close and keep the popup closed after pressing:
- esc
- moving the cursor with the arrow keys
- typing

open a popup when the mouse pointer is moved over a method again.

~This happens in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]~
Update: this happens in both 4.7.beta1 and 4.6.2.stable, when single window mode is enabled, it's disabled by default.


Workaround:
The popup stays closed when esc or any key is held for more than one second.
However, the popup returns when alt + tabbing to another app then back to Godot.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script-mouse-over-popup-doesn't-stay-closed.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27362227/script-mouse-over-popup-doesn.t-stay-closed.zip)
